subject.title: [Feature]: Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept a first-class Alibaba/Qwen Token Plan provider/auth surface in the qwen plugin now, or keep Token Plan users on custom or external-plugin configuration for this plan?
rationale: The request adds a new provider identity, auth choice/env surface, outbound endpoint family, and catalog behavior, so repository policy requires maintainer product intent before treating it as done.

options.title: Accept linked provider PR after review
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94419 is reviewed and, if acceptable, merged as the canonical implementation.

options.title: Keep Token Plan external/custom for now
options.body: Reject bundled provider surface for now and point users to explicit custom provider config or a separate plugin until demand or ownership is clearer.

options.title: Request a narrower qwen-plugin design
options.body: Ask the PR author to reduce or reshape the provider/config surface before maintainers decide whether to merge it.

recommendation.title: Accept linked provider PR after review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94419 is reviewed and, if acceptable, merged as the canonical implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced and recently shaped the qwen provider boundary that the requested provider surface extends.
